purpose: Remove remaining large blank areas caused by forced chapter/reference page breaks while preserving all v0.5 reader content and Evidence bindings.

layout_changes.later_chapter_start_policy: start on the current page only when at least 0.45 text-height is available; otherwise move to the next page
layout_changes.final_synthesis_start_policy: start on the current page only when at least 0.55 text-height is available; otherwise move to the next page

review_reference: Human Visual Review requested more relaxed placement around two-column/full-width transitions; ChatGPT render-first review of v0.5 also found avoidable blank areas at chapter boundaries and before References.
